entries.english:
1. Territorial and hereditary homages, files 11–13.

Contents/inserted notes: 1. Includes, among other things, a dispute with the von Rosenberg zu Waldmannshofen over the homage of Frauental Abbey's subjects (1582). 2. Marking the forests and boundary with Rothenburg near Tauberzell. 3. Dispute with Würzburg Cathedral Chapter over the cent court at Segnitz (1768).
